mapper.select:
SELECT INDI_CD AS indicd, INDI_NM AS indinm, DEFINITION AS definition, NUMER_DESC AS numerdesc, DENOM_DESC AS denomdesc, DENOM_GB AS denomgb,
NUMER_SRC AS numersrc, INCID_GB AS incidgb, MIN_LEVEL AS minlevel, MULTIPLIER AS multiplier, UNIT AS unit, DECIMALS AS decimals, CYCLE_GB AS cyclegb, SOURCE_NM AS sourcenm, METHOD_NM AS methodnm, OWNER_NM AS ownernm, TARGET_VAL AS targetval FROM TBL_QPS_INDI_MST WHERE INDI_CD = #{indiCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND HOSP_CD IN (#{hospCd}, '*') ORDER BY CASE WHEN HOSP_CD = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END LIMIT 1

SELECT PLAN_SEQ AS planseq, IN_YEAR AS inyear, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(SUBMIT_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS submitdt, DATE_FORMAT(UPD_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS upddttm FROM TBL_QPS_PLAN
WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND FORM_GB = IFNULL(#{formGb},'Q') AND IN_YEAR = #{inYear} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_PLAN (HOSP_CD, FORM_GB, IN_YEAR, SUBMIT_DT, USE_YN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, IFNULL(#{formGb},'Q'), #{inYear}, REPLACE(#{submitDt},'-',''), 'Y', #{regUser}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SUBMIT_DT=VALUES(SUBMIT_DT), USE_YN='Y', UPD_USER=#{regUser}, PLAN_SEQ = LAST_INSERT_ID(PLAN_SEQ)
mapper.select: SELECT SECT_CD AS sect, SORT AS sort, GRP AS grp, C1 AS c1, C2 AS c2, C3 AS c3, C4 AS c4, S1 AS s1, S2 AS s2, S3 AS s3, S4 AS s4, S5 AS s5, S6 AS s6, M01 AS m01, M02 AS m02, M03 AS m03, M04 AS m04, M05 AS m05, M06 AS m06, M07 AS m07, M08 AS m08, M09 AS m09, M10 AS m10, M11 AS m11, M12 AS m12, AMT AS amt FROM TBL_QPS_PLAN_ITEM WHERE PLAN_SEQ = #{planSeq} ORDER BY SECT_CD, SORT, IT_SEQ
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_PLAN_ITEM (PLAN_SEQ, SECT_CD, SORT, GRP, C1, C2, C3, C4, S1,S2,S3,S4,S5,S6, M01,M02,M03,M04,M05,M06,M07,M08,M09,M10,M11,M12, AMT) VALUES
(#{planSeq}, #{it.sect}, #{it.sort}, #{it.grp}, #{it.c1}, #{it.c2}, #{it.c3}, #{it.c4}, #{it.s1},#{it.s2},#{it.s3},#{it.s4},#{it.s5},#{it.s6}, #{it.m01},#{it.m02},#{it.m03},#{it.m04},#{it.m05},#{it.m06}, #{it.m07},#{it.m08},#{it.m09},#{it.m10},#{it.m11},#{it.m12}, #{it.amt})
mapper.select:
SELECT RND_SEQ AS rndseq, ROUND_YM AS roundym, CHECKER AS checker, DATE_FORMAT(UPD_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS upddttm FROM TBL_QPS_ROUND
WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND FORM_GB = IFNULL(#{formGb},'Q') AND ROUND_YM = #{roundYm} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_ROUND (HOSP_CD, FORM_GB, ROUND_YM, CHECKER, USE_YN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, IFNULL(#{formGb},'Q'), #{roundYm}, #{checker}, 'Y', #{regUser}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CHECKER=VALUES(CHECKER), USE_YN='Y', UPD_USER=#{regUser}, RND_SEQ = LAST_INSERT_ID(RND_SEQ)
mapper.select: SELECT SORT AS sort, GRP AS grp, C1 AS c1, C2 AS c2, EVAL_GB AS evalgb, C3 AS c3 FROM TBL_QPS_ROUND_ITEM WHERE RND_SEQ = #{rndSeq} ORDER BY SORT, IT_SEQ
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_ROUND_ITEM (RND_SEQ, SORT, GRP, C1, C2, EVAL_GB, C3) VALUES
(#{rndSeq}, #{it.sort}, #{it.grp}, #{it.c1}, #{it.c2}, #{it.evalgb}, #{it.c3})
mapper.select:
SELECT MIN_SEQ AS minseq, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(MEET_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS meetdt, TITLE AS title, PLACE AS place, DATE_FORMAT(UPD_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS upddttm FROM TBL_QPS_MINUTES WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
AND FORM_GB = IFNULL(#{formGb},'Q') AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND MEET_DT LIKE CONCAT(#{inYear}, '%') ORDER BY MEET_DT DESC, MIN_SEQ DESC

SELECT MIN_SEQ AS minseq, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(MEET_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS meetdt, TITLE AS title, MEET_GB AS meetgb, PLACE AS place, PERSONNEL AS personnel, ATTENDEES AS attendees, MEMBERS AS members, AGENDA AS agenda, CONTENT AS content, DECISION AS decision, NEXT_TXT AS nexttxt, ATTACH_TXT AS attachtxt, SPECIAL_TXT AS specialtxt FROM TBL_QPS_MINUTES WHERE MIN_SEQ = #{minSeq} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_MINUTES (HOSP_CD, FORM_GB, MEET_DT, TITLE, MEET_GB, PLACE, PERSONNEL, ATTENDEES, MEMBERS, AGENDA, CONTENT, DECISION, NEXT_TXT, ATTACH_TXT, SPECIAL_TXT, USE_YN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, IFNULL(#{formGb},'Q'), REPLACE(#{meetDt},'-',''), #{title}, #{meetGb}, #{place}, #{personnel}, #{attendees}, #{members}, #{agenda}, #{content}, #{decision}, #{nextTxt}, #{attachTxt}, #{specialTxt}, 'Y', #{regUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QPS_MINUTES SET MEET_DT = REPLACE(#{meetDt},'-',''), TITLE = #{title}, MEET_GB = #{meetGb}, PLACE = #{place}, PERSONNEL = #{personnel}, ATTENDEES = #{attendees}, MEMBERS = #{members}, AGENDA = #{agenda}, CONTENT = #{content}, DECISION = #{decision}, NEXT_TXT = #{nextTxt}, ATTACH_TXT = #{attachTxt}, SPECIAL_TXT = #{specialTxt}, UPD_USER = #{regUser} WHERE MIN_SEQ = #{minSeq} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
UPDATE TBL_QPS_MINUTES SET USE_YN='N', UPD_USER=#{regUser} WHERE MIN_SEQ = #{minSeq} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
mapper.select: SELECT m.INDI_CD AS indicd, m.INDI_NM AS indinm, IFNULL(m.AREA_NM,'기타') AS areanm, IFNULL(m.AREA_NO,99) AS areano, m.NUMER_SRC AS numersrc, r.STATUS AS status, IFNULL(r.CUR_STEP,0) AS curstep, CASE WHEN IFNULL(r.ANALYSIS_TXT,'') <> '' OR IFNULL(r.PLAN_TXT,'') <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS writeyn, DATE_FORMAT(r.UPD_DTTM,'%m-%d %H:%i') AS upddttm FROM TBL_QPS_INDI_MST m LEFT JOIN TBL_QPS_REPORT r ON r.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND r.INDI_CD = m.INDI_CD AND r.PRD_GB = #{prdGb} AND r.PRD_KEY = #{prdKey} WHERE m.USE_YN = 'Y' AND m.HOSP_CD = ( SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_QPS_INDI_MST x WHERE x.INDI_CD = m.INDI_CD AND x.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND x.USE_YN = 'Y' ) THEN #{hospCd} ELSE '*' END ) ORDER BY IFNULL(m.AREA_NO,99), m.SORT_NO

SELECT CODE_CD AS codecd, SUB_CODE AS subcode, RTRIM(SUB_CODE_NM) AS subcodenm FROM TBL_CODE_DTL WHERE CODE_GB = 'Q' AND CODE_CD LIKE 'QPS\_%' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND ACTION_YN = 'Y' AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN IFNULL(START_DT,'00000101') AND IFNULL(END_DT,'99991231') ORDER BY CODE_CD, IFNULL(SORT,99), SUB_CODE

SELECT INDI_CD AS indicd, INDI_NM AS indinm, AREA_NM AS areanm, DEFINITION AS definition, NUMER_DESC AS numerdesc, DENOM_DESC AS denomdesc, MULTIPLIER AS multiplier, UNIT AS unit, DECIMALS AS decimals, CYCLE_GB AS cyclegb, SOURCE_NM AS sourcenm, METHOD_NM AS methodnm, OWNER_NM AS ownernm, DEPT_NM AS deptnm, BACKGROUND AS background, INCLUDE_TXT AS includetxt, EXCLUDE_TXT AS excludetxt, TARGET_VAL AS targetval, PREV_VAL AS prevval, TARGET_BASE AS targetbase, RPT_CYCLE AS rptcycle, RPT_SCOPE AS rptscope, SHARE_TXT AS sharetxt, NOTE AS note, NUMER_SRC AS numersrc, DENOM_GB AS denomgb, CASE WHEN HOSP_CD = '*' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS own, DATE_FORMAT(UPD_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS upddttm FROM TBL_QPS_INDI_MST WHERE INDI_CD = #{indiCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND HOSP_CD IN (#{hospCd}, '*') ORDER BY CASE WHEN HOSP_CD = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_INDI_MST (HOSP_CD, INDI_CD, INDI_NM, AREA_NM, AREA_NO, DEFINITION, NUMER_DESC, DENOM_DESC, DENOM_GB, NUMER_SRC, INCID_GB, MIN_LEVEL, MULTIPLIER, UNIT, DECIMALS, CYCLE_GB, SOURCE_NM, METHOD_NM, OWNER_NM, DEPT_NM, BACKGROUND, INCLUDE_TXT, EXCLUDE_TXT, TARGET_VAL, PREV_VAL, TARGET_BASE, RPT_CYCLE, RPT_SCOPE, SHARE_TXT, NOTE, SORT_NO, USE_YN, REG_USER) SELECT #{hospCd}, m.INDI_CD, #{indiNm}, m.AREA_NM, m.AREA_NO, #{definition}, #{numerDesc}, #{denomDesc}, m.DENOM_GB, m.NUMER_SRC, m.INCID_GB, m.MIN_LEVEL, m.MULTIPLIER, m.UNIT, m.DECIMALS, m.CYCLE_GB, #{sourceNm}, #{methodNm}, #{ownerNm}, #{deptNm}, #{background}, #{includeTxt}, #{excludeTxt}, #{targetVal}, #{prevVal}, #{targetBase}, #{rptCycle}, #{rptScope}, #{shareTxt}, #{note}, m.SORT_NO, 'Y', #{regUser} FROM TBL_QPS_INDI_MST m WHERE m.INDI_CD = #{indiCd} AND m.HOSP_CD = '*' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE INDI_NM=VALUES(INDI_NM), DEFINITION=VALUES(DEFINITION), NUMER_DESC=VALUES(NUMER_DESC), DENOM_DESC=VALUES(DENOM_DESC), SOURCE_NM=VALUES(SOURCE_NM), METHOD_NM=VALUES(METHOD_NM), OWNER_NM=VALUES(OWNER_NM), DEPT_NM=VALUES(DEPT_NM), BACKGROUND=VALUES(BACKGROUND), INCLUDE_TXT=VALUES(INCLUDE_TXT), EXCLUDE_TXT=VALUES(EXCLUDE_TXT), TARGET_VAL=VALUES(TARGET_VAL), PREV_VAL=VALUES(PREV_VAL), TARGET_BASE=VALUES(TARGET_BASE), RPT_CYCLE=VALUES(RPT_CYCLE), RPT_SCOPE=VALUES(RPT_SCOPE), SHARE_TXT=VALUES(SHARE_TXT), NOTE=VALUES(NOTE), USE_YN='Y', UPD_USER=#{regUser}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_QPS_INDI_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND INDI_CD = #{indiCd} AND HOSP_CD <> '*'
mapper.select:
SELECT m.INDI_CD AS indicd, m.INDI_NM AS indinm, IFNULL(m.AREA_NM,'기타') AS areanm, IFNULL(m.AREA_NO, 99) AS areano, m.NUMER_SRC AS numersrc, m.DENOM_GB AS denomgb, m.MULTIPLIER AS multiplier, m.UNIT AS unit, m.CYCLE_GB AS cyclegb, m.DEFINITION AS definition, m.TARGET_VAL AS targetval, m.SORT_NO AS sortno,
CASE WHEN m.HOSP_CD = '*' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS defown, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_QPS_INCIDENT i WHERE i.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND i.USE_YN='Y' AND i.INCID_GB = IFNULL(m.INCID_GB, m.INDI_CD) AND SUBSTRING(i.OCCUR_DT,1,4) = #{inYear} ) AS incidcnt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_QPS_MONITOR o WHERE o.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND o.USE_YN='Y' AND o.INDI_CD = m.INDI_CD AND SUBSTRING(o.OBS_DT,1,4) = #{inYear} ) AS moncnt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_QPS_MANUAL u WHERE u.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND u.USE_YN='Y' AND u.INDI_CD = m.INDI_CD AND u.IN_YEAR = #{inYear} ) AS mancnt FROM TBL_QPS_INDI_MST m WHERE m.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND m.HOSP_CD = ( SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_QPS_INDI_MST x WHERE x.INDI_CD = m.INDI_CD AND x.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND x.USE_YN = 'Y' ) THEN #{hospCd} ELSE '*' END ) ORDER BY IFNULL(m.AREA_NO,99), m.SORT_NO
SELECT h.HOSP_CD AS hospcd, h.HOSP_NM AS hospnm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO i WHERE i.HOSP_CD = h.HOSP_CD) AS ipwoncnt FROM TBL_HOSP_MST h WHERE h.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} LIMIT 1

SELECT i.CHARTNO AS ptno, i.PATNAME AS ptnm, NULLIF(TRIM(i.WORD_NM),'') AS wardnm, NULLIF(TRIM(i.ROOM_NM),'') AS roomnm, LEFT(REPLACE(i.IPWONDT,'-',''),8) AS ipwondt, LEFT(REPLACE(i.TEWONDT,'-',''),8) AS tewondt, i.DEPT_NM AS deptnm, CASE WHEN LENGTH(REPLACE(i.JUMINNO,'-','')) = 13 THEN CASE WHEN MOD(CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(i.JUMINNO,'-',''),7,1) AS UNSIGNED),2) = 1 THEN 'M' ELSE 'F' END END AS ptsex, CASE WHEN LENGTH(REPLACE(i.JUMINNO,'-','')) = 13 THEN CAST(LEFT(#{baseDt},4) AS SIGNED) - ( CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(i.JUMINNO,'-',''),7,1) IN ('1','2','5','6') THEN 1900 WHEN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(i.JUMINNO,'-',''),7,1) IN ('3','4','7','8') THEN 2000 ELSE 1800 END + CAST(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(i.JUMINNO,'-',''),1,2) AS UNSIGNED) ) END AS ptage, CASE WHEN LEFT(REPLACE(i.IPWONDT,'-',''),8) <= #{baseDt} AND ( i.TEWONDT IS NULL OR TRIM(i.TEWONDT) = '' OR LEFT(REPLACE(i.TEWONDT,'-',''),8) >= #{baseDt} ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS inhospyn FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO i JOIN ( SELECT HOSP_CD, CHARTNO, MAX(CONCAT(JOBYYMM,'|',LPAD(SEQ_NUM,8,'0'))) k FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY HOSP_CD, CHARTNO ) m ON m.HOSP_CD = i.HOSP_CD AND m.CHARTNO = i.CHARTNO AND m.k = CONCAT(i.JOBYYMM,'|',LPAD(i.SEQ_NUM,8,'0')) WHERE i.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND i.CHARTNO IS NOT NULL AND i.CHARTNO <> '' AND ( i.CHARTNO LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR i.PATNAME LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY inhospyn DESC, i.IPWONDT DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT INCID_SEQ AS incidseq, nm.PATNAME AS ptnm, OCCUR_DT AS occurdt, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(OCCUR_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS occurdtfmt, OCCUR_TM AS occurtm, WARD_CD AS wardcd, RPT_DEPT AS rptdept, PT_NO AS ptno, PT_SEX AS ptsex, PT_AGE AS ptage, LEVEL_CD AS levelcd, TYPE_CD AS typecd, SUBTYPE_CD AS subtypecd, PLACE_CD AS placecd, DAMAGE_CD AS damagecd, CAUSE_TXT AS causetxt, ACTION_TXT AS actiontxt, RPT_USER AS rptuser, STATUS AS status, DATE_FORMAT(UPD_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS upddttm FROM TBL_QPS_INCIDENT t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT HOSP_CD, CHARTNO, MAX(PATNAME) PATNAME FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY HOSP_CD, CHARTNO ) nm ON nm.HOSP_CD = t.HOSP_CD AND nm.CHARTNO = t.PT_NO WHERE t.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND t.INCID_GB = #{incidGb} AND t.USE_YN = 'Y' AND t.OCCUR_DT >= #{fromDt} AND t.OCCUR_DT <= #{toDt} ORDER BY t.OCCUR_DT DESC, t.INCID_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_INCIDENT (HOSP_CD, INCID_GB, OCCUR_DT, OCCUR_TM, WARD_CD, RPT_DEPT, PT_NO, PT_SEX, PT_AGE, LEVEL_CD, TYPE_CD, SUBTYPE_CD, PLACE_CD, DAMAGE_CD, CAUSE_TXT, ACTION_TXT, RPT_USER, STATUS, USE_YN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{incidGb}, REPLACE(#{occurDt},'-',''), #{occurTm}, #{wardCd}, #{rptDept}, #{ptNo}, #{ptSex}, #{ptAge}, #{levelCd}, #{typeCd}, #{subtypeCd}, #{placeCd}, #{damageCd}, #{causeTxt}, #{actionTxt}, #{rptUser}, IFNULL(#{status},'DRAFT'), 'Y', #{regUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QPS_INCIDENT SET OCCUR_DT = REPLACE(#{occurDt},'-',''), OCCUR_TM = #{occurTm}, WARD_CD = #{wardCd}, RPT_DEPT = #{rptDept}, PT_NO = #{ptNo}, PT_SEX = #{ptSex}, PT_AGE = #{ptAge}, LEVEL_CD = #{levelCd}, TYPE_CD = #{typeCd}, SUBTYPE_CD = #{subtypeCd}, PLACE_CD = #{placeCd}, DAMAGE_CD = #{damageCd}, CAUSE_TXT = #{causeTxt}, ACTION_TXT = #{actionTxt}, RPT_USER = #{rptUser}, UPD_USER = #{updUser} WHERE INCID_SEQ = #{incidSeq} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
mapper.select: SELECT indt, outdt FROM ( SELECT CHARTNO, LEFT(REPLACE(IPWONDT,'-',''),8) AS indt, MAX(CASE WHEN LEFT(REPLACE(TEWONDT,'-',''),8) REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}$' THEN LEFT(REPLACE(TEWONDT,'-',''),8) ELSE '' END) AS outdt FROM TBL_IPWON_INFO WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND LEFT(REPLACE(IPWONDT,'-',''),8) REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}$' AND LEFT(REPLACE(IPWONDT,'-',''),8) <= #{yearEnd} GROUP BY CHARTNO, LEFT(REPLACE(IPWONDT,'-',''),8) ) s WHERE ( s.outdt = '' OR s.outdt >= #{yearStart} )

SELECT MON_SEQ AS monseq, OBS_DT AS obsdt, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(OBS_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS obsdtfmt, WARD_CD AS wardcd, JOB_GB AS jobgb, MOMENT_CD AS momentcd, OBS_CNT AS obscnt, PASS_CNT AS passcnt, CASE WHEN OBS_CNT > 0 THEN ROUND(PASS_CNT*100/OBS_CNT, 1) END AS ratepct, OBSERVER AS observer, NOTE AS note, DATE_FORMAT(UPD_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS upddttm FROM TBL_QPS_MONITOR WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND INDI_CD = #{indiCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND OBS_DT >= #{fromDt} AND OBS_DT <= #{toDt} ORDER BY OBS_DT DESC, MON_SEQ DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_MONITOR (HOSP_CD, INDI_CD, OBS_DT, WARD_CD, JOB_GB, MOMENT_CD, OBS_CNT, PASS_CNT, OBSERVER, NOTE, USE_YN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{indiCd}, REPLACE(#{obsDt},'-',''), #{wardCd}, #{jobGb}, #{momentCd}, IFNULL(#{obsCnt},0), IFNULL(#{passCnt},0), #{observer}, #{note}, 'Y', #{regUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QPS_MONITOR SET OBS_DT = REPLACE(#{obsDt},'-',''), WARD_CD = #{wardCd}, JOB_GB = #{jobGb}, MOMENT_CD= #{momentCd}, OBS_CNT = IFNULL(#{obsCnt},0), PASS_CNT = IFNULL(#{passCnt},0), OBSERVER = #{observer}, NOTE = #{note}, UPD_USER = #{updUser} WHERE MON_SEQ = #{monSeq} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
UPDATE TBL_QPS_MONITOR SET USE_YN='N', UPD_USER=#{updUser} WHERE MON_SEQ = #{monSeq} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
mapper.select: SELECT 'JOB' AS axis, IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_GB),''),'미상') AS code, SUM(PASS_CNT) AS numer, SUM(OBS_CNT) AS denom FROM TBL_QPS_MONITOR WHERE HOSP_CD=#{hospCd} AND INDI_CD=#{indiCd} AND USE_YN='Y' AND OBS_DT >= #{fromDt} AND OBS_DT <= #{toDt} GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_GB),''),'미상') UNION ALL SELECT 'WARD' AS axis, IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(WARD_CD),''),'미상') AS code, SUM(PASS_CNT), SUM(OBS_CNT) FROM TBL_QPS_MONITOR WHERE HOSP_CD=#{hospCd} AND INDI_CD=#{indiCd} AND USE_YN='Y' AND OBS_DT >= #{fromDt} AND OBS_DT <= #{toDt} GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(WARD_CD),''),'미상') UNION ALL SELECT 'MOMENT' AS axis, IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(MOMENT_CD),''),'미상') AS code, SUM(PASS_CNT), SUM(OBS_CNT) FROM TBL_QPS_MONITOR WHERE HOSP_CD=#{hospCd} AND INDI_CD=#{indiCd} AND USE_YN='Y' AND OBS_DT >= #{fromDt} AND OBS_DT <= #{toDt} GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(MOMENT_CD),''),'미상')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_CENSUS (HOSP_CD, CENSUS_GB, IN_YEAR, M01,M02,M03,M04,M05,M06,M07,M08,M09,M10,M11,M12, USE_YN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{censusGb}, #{inYear}, #{m01},#{m02},#{m03},#{m04},#{m05},#{m06},#{m07},#{m08},#{m09},#{m10},#{m11},#{m12}, 'Y', #{regUser}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE M01=VALUES(M01), M02=VALUES(M02), M03=VALUES(M03), M04=VALUES(M04), M05=VALUES(M05), M06=VALUES(M06), M07=VALUES(M07), M08=VALUES(M08), M09=VALUES(M09), M10=VALUES(M10), M11=VALUES(M11), M12=VALUES(M12), USE_YN='Y', UPD_USER=#{updUser}

INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_MANUAL (HOSP_CD, INDI_CD, IN_YEAR, VAL_GB, AXIS_CD, M01,M02,M03,M04,M05,M06,M07,M08,M09,M10,M11,M12, USE_YN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{indiCd}, #{inYear}, #{valGb}, IFNULL(#{axisCd},''), #{m01},#{m02},#{m03},#{m04},#{m05},#{m06},#{m07},#{m08},#{m09},#{m10},#{m11},#{m12}, 'Y', #{regUser}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE M01=VALUES(M01), M02=VALUES(M02), M03=VALUES(M03), M04=VALUES(M04), M05=VALUES(M05), M06=VALUES(M06), M07=VALUES(M07), M08=VALUES(M08), M09=VALUES(M09), M10=VALUES(M10), M11=VALUES(M11), M12=VALUES(M12), USE_YN='Y', UPD_USER=#{updUser}
mapper.select: SELECT SUBSTRING(ULCER_DT, 5, 2) AS mm, COUNT(DISTINCT PAT_ID, ULCER_DT) AS cnt FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND NEW_ULCER = '1' AND ULCER_DT REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}$' AND SUBSTRING(ULCER_DT, 1, 4) = #{inYear} GROUP BY SUBSTRING(ULCER_DT, 5, 2)

SELECT SUBSTRING(t.firstdt, 5, 2) AS mm, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT PAT_ID, MIN(DOC_DT) AS firstdt FROM TBL_PATVAL_MST WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND UTI = '1' AND DOC_DT REGEXP '^[0-9]{8}$' GROUP BY PAT_ID ) t WHERE SUBSTRING(t.firstdt, 1, 4) = #{inYear} GROUP BY SUBSTRING(t.firstdt, 5, 2)

SELECT 'PLACE' AS axis, IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(PLACE_CD),''),'미상') AS code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TBL_QPS_INCIDENT WHERE HOSP_CD=#{hospCd} AND INCID_GB=#{incidGb} AND USE_YN='Y' AND OCCUR_DT >= #{fromDt} AND OCCUR_DT <= #{toDt} AND ( IFNULL(#{minLevel},'') = '' OR CAST(REPLACE(IFNULL(LEVEL_CD,'LV0'),'LV','') AS UNSIGNED) >= CAST(#{minLevel} AS UNSIGNED) ) GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(PLACE_CD),''),'미상') UNION ALL SELECT 'DAMAGE' AS axis, IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(DAMAGE_CD),''),'미상') AS code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TBL_QPS_INCIDENT WHERE HOSP_CD=#{hospCd} AND INCID_GB=#{incidGb} AND USE_YN='Y' AND OCCUR_DT >= #{fromDt} AND OCCUR_DT <= #{toDt} AND ( IFNULL(#{minLevel},'') = '' OR CAST(REPLACE(IFNULL(LEVEL_CD,'LV0'),'LV','') AS UNSIGNED) >= CAST(#{minLevel} INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_INFPAT_ITEM (IPAT_SEQ, SORT, IN_DT, CHK_DT, DISEASE, PAT_NO, PAT_NM, SEX_NM, AGE_VAL, IN_HOSP, ACT_TXT) VALUES
(#{ipatSeq}, #{it.sort}, REPLACE(#{it.indt},'-',''), REPLACE(#{it.chkdt},'-',''), #{it.disease}, #{it.patno}, #{it.patnm}, #{it.sexnm}, #{it.ageval}, #{it.inhosp}, #{it.acttxt})
mapper.select: SELECT STF_SEQ AS stfseq, STF_NM AS stfnm, DEPT_NM AS deptnm, POSITION AS position, DATE_FORMAT(UPD_DTTM,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS upddttm FROM TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY STF_SEQ DESC

SELECT STF_SEQ AS stfseq, STF_NM AS stfnm, DEPT_NM AS deptnm, POSITION AS position, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(APPT_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS apptdt, JOB_KIND AS jobkind, CAREER_TXT AS careertxt, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(JOIN_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS joindt, RANK_NM AS ranknm, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(DEPT_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS deptdt, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(DUTY_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS dutydt, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(WRITE_DT,'%Y%m%d'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS writedt, EDU_LEVEL AS edulevel, MAJOR_TXT AS majortxt, LICENSE_TXT AS licensetxt, CAREER_REQ AS careerreq FROM TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF WHERE STF_SEQ = #{stfSeq} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF (HOSP_CD, STF_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION, APPT_DT, JOB_KIND, CAREER_TXT, JOIN_DT, RANK_NM, DEPT_DT, DUTY_DT, WRITE_DT, EDU_LEVEL, MAJOR_TXT, LICENSE_TXT, CAREER_REQ, USE_YN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{stfNm}, #{deptNm}, #{position}, REPLACE(#{apptDt},'-',''), #{jobKind}, #{careerTxt}, REPLACE(#{joinDt},'-',''), #{rankNm}, REPLACE(#{deptDt},'-',''), REPLACE(#{dutyDt},'-',''), REPLACE(#{writeDt},'-',''), #{eduLevel}, #{majorTxt}, #{licenseTxt}, #{careerReq}, 'Y', #{regUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF SET STF_NM=#{stfNm}, DEPT_NM=#{deptNm}, POSITION=#{position}, APPT_DT=REPLACE(#{apptDt},'-',''), JOB_KIND=#{jobKind}, CAREER_TXT=#{careerTxt}, JOIN_DT=REPLACE(#{joinDt},'-',''), RANK_NM=#{rankNm}, DEPT_DT=REPLACE(#{deptDt},'-',''), DUTY_DT=REPLACE(#{dutyDt},'-',''), WRITE_DT=REPLACE(#{writeDt},'-',''), EDU_LEVEL=#{eduLevel}, MAJOR_TXT=#{majorTxt}, LICENSE_TXT=#{licenseTxt}, CAREER_REQ=#{careerReq}, UPD_USER=#{regUser} WHERE STF_SEQ=#{stfSeq} AND HOSP_CD=#{hospCd}
UPDATE TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF SET USE_YN='N', UPD_USER=#{regUser} WHERE STF_SEQ=#{stfSeq} AND HOSP_CD=#{hospCd}
mapper.select: SELECT SORT AS sort, ORG_NM AS orgnm, CRS_NM AS crsnm, EDU_DT AS edudt, EDU_TERM AS eduterm FROM TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF_EDU WHERE STF_SEQ = #{stfSeq} ORDER BY SORT
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF_EDU (STF_SEQ, SORT, ORG_NM, CRS_NM, EDU_DT, EDU_TERM) VALUES
(#{stfSeq}, #{it.sort}, #{it.orgnm}, #{it.crsnm}, #{it.edudt}, #{it.eduterm})
mapper.select: SELECT SORT AS sort, DUTY_NM AS dutynm, DUTY_TXT AS dutytxt, DUTY_CYC AS dutycyc FROM TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF_DUTY WHERE STF_SEQ = #{stfSeq} ORDER BY SORT
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_INFSTAFF_DUTY (STF_SEQ, SORT, DUTY_NM, DUTY_TXT, DUTY_CYC) VALUES
(#{stfSeq}, #{it.sort}, #{it.dutynm}, #{it.dutytxt}, #{it.dutycyc})
mapper.select: SELECT d.SORT AS sort, d.AREA_CD AS areacd, d.Q_NO AS qno, d.Q_NM AS qnm, c.SUB_CODE_NM AS areanm FROM TBL_QPS_SRV_DEF d LEFT JOIN TBL_CODE_DTL c ON c.CODE_CD='QPS_SRV_AREA' AND c.SUB_CODE=d.AREA_CD AND c.USE_YN='Y' WHERE d.USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY d.SORT

SELECT SURVEY_ID AS surveyid, IN_YEAR AS inyear, SEQ AS seq, SURVEY_NM AS surveynm, FR_DT AS frdt, TO_DT AS todt, CLOSE_YN AS closeyn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS a WHERE a.SURVEY_ID = s.SURVEY_ID) AS anscnt FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY s WHERE s.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND s.IN_YEAR = #{inYear} ORDER BY s.IN_YEAR DESC, s.SEQ DESC

SELECT SURVEY_ID AS surveyid, HOSP_CD AS hospcd, IN_YEAR AS inyear, SEQ AS seq, SURVEY_NM AS surveynm, PURPOSE AS purpose, GOAL AS goal, FR_DT AS frdt, TO_DT AS todt, TARGET AS target, METHOD AS method, STAFF AS staff, STAT_METHOD AS statmethod, USE_PLAN AS useplan, CLOSE_YN AS closeyn, IMPR_TXT AS imprtxt, STRATEGY_TXT AS strategytxt, CONCL_TXT AS concltxt, NEXTACT_TXT AS nextacttxt FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SEQ),0)+1 FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY WHERE HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND IN_YEAR = #{inYear}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_SURVEY (HOSP_CD, IN_YEAR, SEQ, SURVEY_NM, PURPOSE, GOAL, FR_DT, TO_DT, TARGET, METHOD, STAFF, STAT_METHOD, USE_PLAN, IMPR_TXT, STRATEGY_TXT, CONCL_TXT, NEXTACT_TXT, REG_USER) VALUES (#{hospCd}, #{inYear}, #{seq}, #{surveynm}, #{purpose}, #{goal}, #{frdt}, #{todt}, #{target}, #{method}, #{staff}, #{statmethod}, #{useplan}, #{imprtxt}, #{strategytxt}, #{concltxt}, #{nextacttxt}, #{regUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_QPS_SURVEY SET SURVEY_NM=#{surveynm}, PURPOSE=#{purpose}, GOAL=#{goal}, FR_DT=#{frdt}, TO_DT=#{todt}, TARGET=#{target}, METHOD=#{method}, STAFF=#{staff}, STAT_METHOD=#{statmethod}, USE_PLAN=#{useplan}, IMPR_TXT=#{imprtxt}, STRATEGY_TXT=#{strategytxt}, CONCL_TXT=#{concltxt}, NEXTACT_TXT=#{nextacttxt}, UPD_USER=#{updUser} WHERE SURVEY_ID=#{surveyId} AND HOSP_CD=#{hospCd}
mapper.select: SELECT ANS_ID AS ansid, ANS_NO AS ansno, WRITER_CD AS writercd, SEX_CD AS sexcd, AGE_CD AS agecd, ETC_OPN AS etcopn, DATE_FORMAT(REG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d') AS regdt FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} ORDER BY ANS_NO, ANS_ID
SELECT Q_SORT AS qsort, SCORE AS score FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ITEM WHERE ANS_ID = #{ansId}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(ANS_NO),0)+1 FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS (SURVEY_ID, HOSP_CD, ANS_NO, WRITER_CD, SEX_CD, AGE_CD, ETC_OPN, REG_USER) VALUES (#{surveyId}, #{hospCd}, #{ansno}, #{writercd}, #{sexcd}, #{agecd}, #{etcopn}, #{regUser})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS WHERE ANS_ID = #{ansId} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ITEM (ANS_ID, Q_SORT, SCORE) VALUES
(#{ansId}, #{it.qsort}, #{it.score})
mapper.select: SELECT i.Q_SORT AS qsort, SUM(i.SCORE=5) AS n5, SUM(i.SCORE=4) AS n4, SUM(i.SCORE=3) AS n3, SUM(i.SCORE=2) AS n2, SUM(i.SCORE=1) AS n1, COUNT(i.SCORE) AS cnt, SUM(i.SCORE) AS sumscore, COUNT(i.SCORE)*5 AS totscore, ROUND(SUM(i.SCORE)/(COUNT(i.SCORE)*5)*100,1) AS pct, ROUND(SUM(i.SCORE)/COUNT(i.SCORE),1) AS avgp FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ITEM i JOIN TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS a ON a.ANS_ID = i.ANS_ID WHERE a.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND a.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY i.Q_SORT ORDER BY i.Q_SORT

SELECT d.AREA_CD AS areacd, COUNT(i.SCORE) AS cnt, SUM(i.SCORE) AS sumscore, ROUND(SUM(i.SCORE)/(COUNT(i.SCORE)*5)*100,1) AS pct, ROUND(SUM(i.SCORE)/COUNT(i.SCORE),1) AS avgp FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ITEM i JOIN TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS a ON a.ANS_ID = i.ANS_ID JOIN TBL_QPS_SRV_DEF d ON d.SORT = i.Q_SORT WHERE a.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND a.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY d.AREA_CD ORDER BY d.AREA_CD

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ANS_ID) AS anscnt, COUNT(i.SCORE) AS cnt, SUM(i.SCORE) AS sumscore, ROUND(SUM(i.SCORE)/(COUNT(i.SCORE)*5)*100,1) AS pct, ROUND(SUM(i.SCORE)/COUNT(i.SCORE),1) AS avgp FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ITEM i JOIN TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS a ON a.ANS_ID = i.ANS_ID WHERE a.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND a.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd}

SELECT
IFNULL(a.AGE_CD,'') IFNULL(a.WRITER_CD,'') IFNULL(a.SEX_CD,'')
AS cd, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS a WHERE a.SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND a.HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} GROUP BY cd ORDER BY cd
SELECT ANS_NO AS ansno, ETC_OPN AS etcopn FROM TBL_QPS_SURVEY_ANS WHERE SURVEY_ID = #{surveyId} AND HOSP_CD = #{hospCd} AND ETC_OPN IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(ETC_OPN) <> '' ORDER BY ANS_NO, ANS_ID
